question: Does adding public BARC harvest/planting labels (extra field-years) to training improve model v2 on the 44 official labeled field-years?
protocol: Outer 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by OBJECTID over the 44 official rows only (identical folds to the saved v2 evaluation); extras appended to training folds only, minus every extra row of a test-fold field; v2 code path (experiment.fit, candidate H) unchanged; main seeds 0-19 (v2 selection seeds), seed 42 = saved split, seeds 0-99 sensitivity.

conditions.b_peak: post hoc: b minus extras whose peak_ndvi < min peak_ndvi of the folds official training rows (label-blind)
conditions.c_peak: post hoc: c with the same peak filter
